name: Scatter plot
reader_question: Do two continuous measures move together across the items, and which items depart from the pattern?
relationship: Association between two continuous measures observed on the same items; no causal direction implied.
use_when: Each item has two continuous measures on stated units
The shape of the cloud and the position of a few named items matter more than exact values
avoid_when: A third measure must be shown as size — use bubble
A decision threshold divides the items into groups — use threshold-scatter
The x measure is time — use a line chart

data_contract.notes: Explicit axis range; every point must fall inside it
Optional positioned label (at most 6 labelled points)
At most one point drawn in the accent

units: Each axis states its own unit; axes are independent and not zero-based by rule, so ranges are declared explicitly.

editable: Native scatter chart with embedded workbook (Edit Data)
not_data_bound: Point labels are positioned text boxes computed from the fixture, not bound to the chart; they do not move if data is edited

table_alternative: A two-column table (item, x, y) for exact lookup.
variations: Bubble chart with a third measure as area
limitations: Correlation is not causation; the exhibit shows association only
Labels for named points are positioned, so they need re-placing after a data edit
Dense overlap beyond about 30 points hides items

excluded_alternatives.reason: Implies an ordering or time path the data does not carry
A fitted line is model output and would overstate a small synthetic sample
